DOR

Source: R/DOR.R
DOR.Rd

Calculate Diagnostic Odds Ratio for features. The DOR is a measure of gene specificity for a cell cluster, defined as (TP/FP)/(FN/TN) where TP = cells in cluster expressing gene, FP = cells outside cluster expressing gene, FN = cells in cluster not expressing gene, TN = cells outside cluster not expressing gene.

Usage

DOR(object, ident, features, assay = "RNA", pseudo = 0.5)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object

ident

Cell identity of interest

features

Features of interest to calculate DOR

assay

Assay to use for DOR calculation. Default "RNA"

pseudo

Pseudocount to avoid division by zero. Default 0.5 (Haldane-Anscombe correction)

Value

Named numeric vector of log-transformed DOR values
